mapper.select: select o.organization_id id, o.name from b_organization o, r_user_tenant rut where o.flag = 1 and rut.flag = 1 and o.organization_id = rut.organization_id and rut.user_id = #{userId}
select a.* from b_organization a LEFT JOIN r_user_tenant b ON b.organization_id = a.organization_id LEFT JOIN b_user c ON c.user_id = b.user_id where c.flag = 1 and c.user_id = #{userId}
select name AS label, organization_id AS value from b_organization where flag != -1 and parameter ->> "$.serviceType" != 0

select a.organization_id, a.parameter ->> '$.fullName' as full_name, a.parameter ->> '$.serviceType' as service_type, a.parameter ->> '$.type' as type, a.parameter ->> '$.filepath' as filepath from b_organization a where a.flag = 1 and a.parameter ->> '$.serviceType' != 0 order by a.parameter ->> '$.serviceType', a.create_time asc
